detail.title: 4 × 8MP WizMind Multi-Sensor Panoramic Bullet Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-PFW83242-A180-S2 4 × 8MP WizMind Multi-Sensor Panoramic Bullet Network Camera Key Points • 32 MP Ultra-High-Definition Resolution, Outputs Max. 32MP (8192 × 3840) @30 fps • 180° Splicing Image. Field of View: H: 180°; V: 100° • 4 × 8MP, 1/1.8" CMOS Image Sensors • Built-in IR LED, the Max. Illumination Distance is 30 m • AI Functions: Crowd Map, Vehicle Density, Perimeter Protection, EPTZ • IP67 and IK10 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments • Anti-Corrosion Design (optional) for Reliable Protection • AR Panorama Technology, Various AR Tags Can be Overlaid Sales Enquiry Datasheet
